layerSemantics.layerA: prediction quality on the FULL common grid (identical outcome definitions; 100% coverage; the only layer where improvement claims may be made)
layerSemantics.layerB: one identical standardized fixed-horizon policy for every candidate — direction-quality differences only, no exit-policy tuning, constant sizing, train-only thresholds

outcomeDefinitions.up: forward close-to-close simple return over H M5 bars > 0
outcomeDefinitions.cont: forward return sign === past W-bar return sign (both strict)
outcomeDefinitions.rev: |past W-bar return| > 0.5*sigma_W AND forward sign opposite
outcomeDefinitions.grid: FULL common grid including rejected/abstained opportunities; abstention never shrinks the evaluation denominator
